title: Expect jam-free drive on upgraded Jln Genting Kelang | The Star
text: Expect jam-free drive on upgraded Jln Genting Kelang | The Star × View Community Expect jam-free drive on upgraded Jln Genting Kelang By SHALINI RAVINDRAN Wednesday, 12 Aug 2015 | 12:00 AM MYT share bookmark Related Stories Singapore 26 Sep 2026 Air quality in Singapore's central region back in unhealthy range; 24-hour PSI reading at 108 Singapore 1d ago Haze in Singapore: Air quality in all five regions unhealthy, PM2.5 readings elevated across island Singapore 19 Sep 2026 Haze in Singapore: PSI in central region back in the unhealthy range A more jam-free road: The RM39.6mil project involved the widening of a portion of Jalan Genting Kelang, totalling 1.5km from four lanes to six lanes. MOTORISTS plying Jalan Genting Kelang in Kuala Lumpur can look forward to a more jam-free route as the road has been upgraded by Kuala Lumpur City Hall (DBKL). Federal Territories Minister Datuk Seri Tengku Adnan Tengku Mansor said the upgrading of the road signified the end of the second phase of the project. Already a subscriber?
